cc:Work.dc:title: Synthetic bullish and bearish SFP geometry
cc:Work.dc:description: Original synthetic illustration. Bullish O=105,H=106,L=97,C=101 against prior low=100. Bearish mirror O=195,H=203,L=194,C=199 against prior high=200. Two right bars confirm pivot=4 at bar=6. No future outcome shown.
